title: Protection Loading Carried on the Booked Average of a Refined Fuels Account
content:
Where the programme an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts sits on carries downside protection, the fee that protection is sold at is loaded onto the gallons-weighted average of the bookings. How much is loaded turns on the gallons standing to the member's credit.

1. Where the programme carries downside protection and the gallons standing to the member's credit reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protection loading is the programme's protection fee per gallon in full.
2. Where the programme carries downside protection and those gallons fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protection loading is the programme's protection fee per gallon taken at a share of 0.5, carried to four decimal places.
3. Where the programme carries no downside protection, nothing is loaded onto the average for downside protection.

## The three lines

| The programme | Gallons standing to the member's credit | Protection loading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carries downside protection | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The programme's protection fee per gallon |
| Carries downside protection | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Half that fee, at a share of 0.5, to four decimal places |
| Carries no downside protection | Either way | Nothing |

Whether the programme carries protection at all, and the fee it is sold at, are written in the catalogue for the programme the account sits on. The gallons standing to the member's credit are read off the account.

*Hypothetical.* On a programme whose protection fee is 0.12 USD per gallon and whose minimum pre-buy gallons stand at 1000, an account with 1500.0 gallons standing to the member's credit carries a loading of 0.1200 USD per gallon. The same account with 900.0 gallons standing carries 0.0600 USD per gallon. On a programme carrying no protection, nothing is loaded whatever the gallons.
